_comment: Blocklist for the compliance gate (blueprint C.3/6).
Scope is tracked files only: CLAUDE.md and .claude/ are untracked and name the
forbidden forms precisely in order to forbid them, so scanning them would flag
Every entry is matched with word boundaries, case-insensitively.
'institutional' and 'contest' are empty pending the maintainer's token list —
the checker reports the count of configured tokens on every run, so an empty
category is visible rather than silently passing.

terminology.why: The schema is v0.1.0; v0.1.1 is the release that publishes it. Correct form: MSD schema v0.1.0 (release v0.1.1).

scoped.why: The public face is tool-neutral and internationally generic; the first bundled case is content, not purpose. Country framing belongs in fixture attribution, not the README.
